objective: Review the completed pulp_ita_dotp shape expansion and decide whether to move to ita_softmax_top or hold for more dotp evidence.

reviewed_result.trend: 64x1 state-parallel timing is much more favorable than 1x64 single-state repeated-step timing in the scoped dotp run.
reviewed_result.weakness: pulp_ita_dotp is only a minimal attention-score dot-product datapath; it does not exercise softmax, reduction, full MHA, paged attention, or KV-cache serving state.

options_reviewed.reason: More dotp shapes would refine timing, but they would not address the main representativeness gap: softmax/reduction behavior.
ita_softmax_top is the smallest already-identified next attention datapath that exercises softmax/reduction behavior after dotp.
options_reviewed.weakness: The active surface grows beyond dotp and pulls ITA package/register/divider/max-finder plus common_cells symbols into the boundary.

options_reviewed.reason: Full ITA/MHA would mix too many dependencies and semantic claims before the softmax-top boundary is clean.

active_seed_policy.reason: dotp has completed the scoped first-seed evidence; softmax_top may become the next active ITA seed only through a separate dependency/template boundary gate before measurement.

required_dependency_boundary.dependency_policy: Use the canonical third_party/ITA and third_party/common_cells submodule gitlinks. Do not recursively import all Bender dependencies.

non_claims: not approval to recursively import all Bender dependencies
